brief:
Palestinian Red Crescent teams evacuated 23 patients and 23 companions through the Rafah crossing for treatment outside Gaza, the Shehab Wire reported. The evacuations were coordinated with the World Health Organization and followed preparation at al-Mawasi field hospital.

The operation reflects ongoing efforts to transfer critically ill Palestinians to medical facilities outside the territory amid the humanitarian situation in Gaza.
